subject: Return crinkle paper
body: Hi, the crinkle paper from SO-20802 is a different shade than we expected.
We opened the boxes to check, and we'd like to return all 5.

truth.handling: Only unopened items can come back, and all five boxes were opened, so the reply explains the policy and no return is opened.
